notes.title: The Gyrodisc Super League Online Alpha is live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey Gyrodisc fans!

Last week we announced that we would soon be bringing the Gyrodisc experience online with the release of our Online Alpha branch, giving those brave early adopters among you the chance to play with your Steam friends from all over the globe. Well, after much testing and some last minute bug fixing I’m pleased to announce that the online alpha is now live! A few things to bear in mind before diving in:
[list]
[*]This first version of the alpha only allows you to join matches hosted by players on your Steam friends list (this will change in later updates when we’ve had the chance to add more communication features).
[*]Initially you’ll be limited to two of the games court layouts. We’ll be aiming to roll out the others pretty soon after release.
[*]This is very much an alpha version of the online game, and as such we’re expecting plenty of new issues and bugs that haven’t shown up in the limited testing we can do ourselves (you can see a list of the known issues we’re already chasing on the forum here). If you run into bugs while playing the new branch, please do report them on our ‘Report a Bug’ forum, so we can start squashing the little blighters!
[/list]
So how can you get the build and have a go? Simple. Just open up the game’s property pages in Steam, navigate to the Betas tab, and choose Online from the drop down. Steam should then update your build to the online alpha automatically. Once in, you can host an online game by kicking off the versus side select as normal and switching from ‘local’ to ‘friends’ mode (you’ll see the button prompt for this at the top of the screen). To join a game hosted by a friend choose the Find Friend Match option on the main menu.

So what are you waiting for? Switch over to the online branch now and start showing off those mad disc skills. We’ll see you on the court!

notes.title: Version 0.4.2 is now live on the pre-release branch!
notes.content:
Greetings Gyrodisc fans! Version 0.4.2 has just been released to the Steam pre-release branch for testing. This latest version brings with it a brand new stadium environment to play host to your Gyrodisc matches, the spectacular Sky City Stadium!


Soaring many miles above the surface of the earth, Sky City is home to some of the wealthiest and most celebrated members of society the world over including a number of ex-Gyrodisc Super League champions. Held aloft by the might of Gyro-Tech engines, this migratory metropolis exists in a state of perpetual summer, chasing the fairer season endlessly around the globe for the comfort of its’ wealthy denizens. The Sky City Gyrodisc Stadium orbits the city itself like a great eagle, a constant reminder to those below of the sport’s great wealth and prestige.


With new dynamic camera angles, this glass-floored flying arena provides an impressive new backdrop for your Gyrodisc matches, so switch to the pre-release branch on the game’s property pages in Steam if you want to check it out. As ever, drop in to our discussion and report a bug forums with feedback or to report any issues you encounter, and look out for further updates to the game over the festive period!


[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the new Sky City Stadium arena to the game, selectable on the stadium screen.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some visual artifacts with character portraits on the pre-match screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3.1 is now live on the pre-release branch!
notes.content:
With summer now in full swing, it’s been some time since our last update here on Steam, but we’re finally ready to show people at least part of what we’ve been up to for the last couple of months here at Valiant.

To that end, we’ve just released Gyrodisc Super League v0.3.1 to the Steam pre-release branch, which brings with it our fourth playable character: the irrepressible Aria Mistry! Hailing from India, Aria lacks the raw power that characters like Ivar and John bring to the table and is a little less nimble than Jess. But what she lacks in pure athleticism she makes up for with her mastery of tricky curving shots that can easily wrong foot opponents. In addition, she’s armed with a unique dive that allows her to recover more easily from a misjudged lunge, and is a little quicker than the others whilst charging making opportunistic super moves more of an option.

In addition to Aria’s debut, this update also adds some improved audience models to the arena, and various animation improvements including new strafing animations for the players during the super charge and serve.

Switch over to the prerelease branch in the game’s properties on Steam if you want to check out the new features. As ever we look forward to hearing your feedback on the discussion forum, and please report any bugs you encounter in the relevant Report a Bug forum.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the fourth playable character to the Gyrodisc Super League roster: Aria.
[*]Tweaked the layouts for the Two Nets Two Walls and Chokepoint courts to make it a little easier to throw the disc when close to the centre walls.
[*]All character celebrations are now available for use in arcade control mode (control select will now prompt you to choose buttons for celebration 3 and 4 in this case).
[*]The game now pauses automatically when activating the steam UI
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The disc no longer gets stuck in its on side animation when caught during the super lob spin.
[/list]
[b]Animation:[/b]
[list]
[*]New strafing animations added for all characters during super charges and serving.
[*]Improvements to character celebration anims.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Release branch updated to v0.2.9
notes.content:
We've just rolled out a new v0.2.9 patch to the Steam prerelease branch, which addresses a couple of stability issues from 0.2.7 as well as adding some minor gameplay and animation tweaks. Switch over to the prerelease branch in the game's properties page in Steam to check it out, and as ever, let us know any issues you run into via the Report a Bug forums.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*]Lob reticule now flashes red when the disc is about to land.
[*]Added basic indicators for the different characters stats on the character select screen.
[/list]
Animation:
[list]
[*]Added character specific start of match intro animations.
[*]New directional strafing animations on all characters.
[/list]
Engine:
[list]
[*]Added a dedicated x64 build for windows users.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.7 is now live on the pre-release branch!
notes.content:
It’s been a busy few weeks here at Valiant, with our devs hard at work adding new features to the game, and squashing some of the more troublesome bugs we’ve encountered in testing. This week we’ve been focused on improving stability in preparation for releasing the first batch of these new features out into the wild.

The result is Gyrodisc Super League v0.2.7, which is now live on our Steam pre-release branch ready for testing. The biggest new addition is the release of our third playable character, the veteran Gyrodisc champion Ivar Vidarsson! Ivar is a giant of the game (in more ways than one), and his larger catch box and powerful throws make him a formidable opponent on court. Unfortunately he’s not as spry as he once was, so you’ll need to plan carefully if you don’t want to get caught out by those tricky overhead lobs.

Other notable changes include a number of animation improvements (such as unique character specific idle and diving animations and an improved catch and throw sequence) a simple ‘Tutorial’ screen to explain some of the game’s core controls, and a new ‘Exact angle’ control option that aims to map your throwing angle more closely to the actual analogue stick direction (rather than the current ‘normalised’ system that spreads the possible angles across the whole stick range). Check out the full patch notes below for a more comprehensive list of the changes.

As ever we look forward to hearing your feedback on the discussion forum, and please report any bugs you encounter in the relevant Report a Bug forum so we can get to them as quickly as possible.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*]Added a third playable character to the Gyrodisc Super League roster: Ivar.
[*]Added a new ‘Exact angle’ option (available in the control options screen), which removes the normalisation from the throwing angle when using controllers.
[*]Diving into other players now causes them to lob the disc up in the air, instead of instantly dropping it.
[*]Player’s are now briefly invincible after being hit by dives
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Players can no longer accidentally remove themselves from a team after selecting go on side select
[*]Fixed some issues where the disc could escape the court in rare cases
[*]Fixed an issue where players could sometimes be hit in the back of the head by the disc from incorrect angles
[/list]
Animation:
[list]
[*]Added unique idle animations for all characters.
[*]Added unique diving animations for all characters.
[*]Added an improved catch and throw animation sequence.
[/list]
Engine:
[list]
[*]Updated to the latest unity version release to fix some texture corruption issues when changing display resolutions.
[*]Closer integration with Steam to pave the way for later features.
[/list]
UI / Menus
[list]
[*]Added a new ‘tutorial’ screen, with some handy illustrative videos of the various moves available in Gyrodisc.
[/list]
